patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s stronger parity-shared RY layer and closed CZ ring while consolidating the two global RZ layers into one shared layer. Because RZ gates commute with CZ, separate pre/post layers add redundant depth and parameters. The compact design uses only three distinct ansatz parameters, reducing optimization complexity, gate count, and likely overfitting while preserving parity-sensitive mixing and full-ring entanglement.
